# LiveScore
> Real-time football scores, fixtures, results, tables, and match statistics for leagues and competitions worldwide.

LiveScore provides live football coverage across domestic leagues, cups, and international tournaments, with match timelines, standings, team pages, and competition hubs organized by country and region.

## Core Football Pages
- [Football Home](https://www.livescore.com/en/football/): Main football hub with live scores, fixtures, results, and featured competitions.
- [LiveScore Homepage](https://www.livescore.com/): Entry point for live sports scores, match tracking, and navigation to football coverage.
- [Football Fixtures](https://www.livescore.com/en/football/fixtures/): Upcoming football matches across leagues and competitions.
- [Football Results](https://www.livescore.com/en/football/results/): Recent football results with completed match listings.
- [Football Tables](https://www.livescore.com/en/football/tables/): League standings and rankings for football competitions.
- [Football News](https://www.livescore.com/en/news/): Editorial coverage, previews, reports, and football-related news updates.

## England
- [Premier League](https://www.livescore.com/en/football/england/premier-league/): Live scores, fixtures, results, table, and match details for England's top division.
- [Championship](https://www.livescore.com/en/football/england/championship/): Second-tier English league coverage with scores, fixtures, and standings.
- [League One](https://www.livescore.com/en/football/england/league-1/): Live League One scores, results, fixtures, and table updates.
- [League Two](https://www.livescore.com/en/football/england/league-2/): Match coverage and standings for England's fourth professional tier.
- [FA Cup](https://www.livescore.com/en/football/england/fa-cup/): Scores, fixtures, and knockout progress for England's main cup competition.
- [EFL Cup](https://www.livescore.com/en/football/england/efl-cup/): Live coverage of the English League Cup competition.
